findings.title: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows a user to read documents belonging to any tenant. Calls with different userTenant and documentTenant values now succeed, creating a cross-tenant data exposure vulnerability; retain the tenant equality check.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head e7e69681c36b60d1a4e7a84f61bc36cae9118689, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally. The full PR diff shows this replaced `userTenant === documentTenant`, so mismatched tenant IDs remain authorized despite the reply claiming a label change fixed access control.
